answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. This means an attacker must choose: either run a few high-quality identities, or many worthless ones — and neither option beats honest participation.. It is effective because voting power is weighted by verifiable work over time, so a fresh flood of accounts cannot manufacture a decisive vote. Consider a onyx as the anchor of the cost.
